narrative.overview: The system behaves like a considered personal note rather than a conventional portfolio. Typography, spacing, and a single portrait carry the page; every element is functional and nothing competes with the biography.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained white emphasis within gray prose
Compact, gently rounded controls and imagery

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only when a text interaction needs to announce itself.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Use one sans-serif family throughout; create distinction through weight, color, and spacing.

dos: Do preserve generous empty space around the single reading column.
Do reserve white for identity, emphasis, and direct actions.
Do keep all interaction states subtle but visibly keyboard-accessible.
donts: Don't add cards, shadows, gradients, decorative technology motifs, or ambient animation.
Don't introduce extra portfolio sections into the introduction surface.
Don't widen body copy beyond its comfortable reading measure.
